# pr

## Steps
1. Confirm the branch is `type/short-description`, committed, and ahead of `master`.
2. Run the checks for the touched areas (`pnpm shared:build && pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm --filter <app> lint`, relevant tests). Don't open a PR on red unless it's a draft.
3. Fill `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`: what and why (motivation first), `Closes #n`, ticked areas (`node .agents/scripts/owner.mjs --diff` shows which), how to test, breaking changes.
4. Title is a Conventional Commit (it becomes the squash commit).
5. `git push -u origin HEAD`, then `gh pr create --base master --title "..." --body-file -` (add `--draft` for work in progress).

## Output
The PR URL. Don't merge.
